label: Puerto Rican Slick-Haired Holstein

links.name: USDA NIFA project: slick hair gene in Florida and Caribbean dairies

names.text: No name for a breed was found in any source. The search results describe slick-haired Holsteins (a gene variant), studied in Puerto Rico and Florida, and do not name a Puerto Rican breed. The name as given in the request is not confirmed.

about.text: Holstein cattle carrying the slick-hair gene, a short, sleek coat variant, studied in Puerto Rico for milk and reproduction. The research is a Florida-led effort, and the sources found do not describe a separate registered breed by this name.

sources.text: The NIFA page was opened with WebFetch but returned 404, so the NIFA link is from search text only. The Hoard's article is from WebSearch text, not opened. Revista de la UPR article on Holsteins in Puerto Rico (1967-1973 study of 62 herds) is from search text, not opened. The point that slick Holsteins in Puerto Rico produced 1.2 lb more milk per day is from search text, not opened.

gaps: The request calls this a breed, Tropical Holstein-derived and developed in Puerto Rico, with a regions and source given in the request. None of these is confirmed. The source given in the request (Wikipedia list of dairy cattle breeds) was not opened and lists no such breed in the search results. No origin record, formation date, registry, population, milk yield, composition or DAD-IS status was found. The 'why' from the request is not used because nothing supports it.
